headline: GO-TO-MARKET STRATEGY · ENTERPRISE & MEDIA SALES · AI-ENABLED REVENUE
summary: Revenue and go-to-market operator with eight years of full-cycle B2B, media, and enterprise technology sales, now pairing an individual quota with board-level strategy work for an AI start-up. Wins net-new business from cold — Fortune 500 accounts at TEKsystems, NFL and MLB team partnerships today — by qualifying on the budget that can actually fund a buy and building the CPM, CPA, and unit-economics case a client's finance team can defend. Coaches sellers against daily process and 1:1 metrics, designs the operating cadence a team runs on, and uses Claude and OpenAI models daily to compress research, account mapping, and proposal cycles.

roles.title: Chief Strategy Consultant
roles.context: Consulting engagement, part-time (5–10 hrs/week), concurrent with role below
bullets: Strategic thought partner to the CEO and board, translating business, technology, regulatory, and workforce tradeoffs into board-ready decisions.
Authored the buy-vs-build strategy, redirecting a $600K–$1.5M, 12–24-month EHR build to a $150–400K, 3–6-month compliance layer.
Restructured a proposed $946K/year five-person build into a one-engineer-plus-fractional model at $200–260K/year, a 73% cut.
Own go-to-market for an AI compliance product sold to independent clinical practices — segmentation, positioning, $99/$249 pricing tiers, and channel strategy.
Set the unit-economic gates the business runs on — CAC under $900, payback under 12 months, churn under 5%, TTFV under 7 days — redirecting GTM to channel partners.

roles.title: Advertising Sales Director, Pro Division

bullets: Closed 5 signed NFL and MLB team-media partnerships, all paid in full at signing, including 2 accounts with no prior purchase history.

Modeled a $10.98 blended CPM against 1.32M reach and a $2,849 cost-per-acquisition benchmark to price a $14,500 buy on outcome economics.
Restructured nine property-level commitments into one shared-cost regional placement across competing budget owners with no single decision-maker.
Added ~125 net-new qualified prospects per week to Salesforce through targeted account research and stakeholder mapping.
